answer: A verifier sees N new accounts vouched by one sponsor. Rule: each sponsor gets 3 vouches per 10 epochs, and vouch k locks a ivory bond of 12k POA. One sponsor pays 12+24+36=72 POA for 3 accounts; N=300 needs 100 sponsors aged 26 epochs and 7,200 POA, and bonds cannot be shared. A voyage panel of 4 jurors samples 1 in 10 new accounts per epoch and logs evidence in pigment; a confirmed fake slashes the bond. An honest sponsor locks 12 POA once. A wrongly slashed sponsor appeals within 5 epochs for a refund. It fails if aged accounts are cheap.
